bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$repo"
sha="a62696833bba035ed5b237410a5cd0da7cc0a3f7"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$sha"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 71
mkdir -p .worktrees
stage="$repo/.worktrees/video-pin-url-20261124"
if test -e "$stage"; then
  test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 72
  test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain)" || exit 73
else
  git worktree add --detach "$stage" "$sha"
fi
cd "$stage"
test "$(grep -c 'topicEntryDirectDmUrl(token)' artifacts/bot/src/services/topicDmEntry.ts)" -ge 3 || exit 74
docker build --pull=false -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-gaybbs-pin-url:a626968 .
docker image inspect gace-gaybbs-pin-url:a626968 >/dev/null
echo NEW_MENU_PIN_IMAGE_BUILT=PASS
